president of the Province of Catanzaro
extract: Wanda Ferro (born 24 March 1968) is an Italian politician of Brothers of Italy serving as a member of the Chamber of Deputies. She was first elected in the 2018 general election, and was re-elected in 2022. She served as president of the province of Catanzaro from 2008 to 2014, and was the candidate of the centre-right for president of Calabria in 2014. Since 2022, she has served as undersecretary of the Ministry of the Interior.
